[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Game of life** [LC 289 · Game of Life](https://leetcode.com/problems/game-of-life/){difficulty="Medium"}

Every update must read the *old* neighbours, so a cell cannot simply be overwritten. A cell's value uses only one bit, though, so store the new state in the spare second bit: after one pass every cell holds `old | new << 1`, neighbours are counted from bit 0, and a final pass shifts every cell right by one.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p3-life.]{.card-link}

:::
